title: Backtest Performance
description: Cumulative stage measurements, not per-bar traces. Inclusive stages overlap; exclusive stages can be ranked. CPU/wall is average cores, not database wait time. Final-only executions have no heartbeat until completion.

list.name: config
list.label: Config hash
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT execution_metadata->>'config_hash' AS __text, execution_metadata->>'config_hash' AS __value FROM backtest_performance WHERE execution_metadata ? 'config_hash' ORDER BY 1

list.name: artifact
list.label: Artifact
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT execution_metadata->>'artifact_path' AS __text, execution_metadata->>'artifact_path' AS __value FROM backtest_performance WHERE execution_metadata ? 'artifact_path' ORDER BY 1

list.name: execution
list.label: Execution
list.query: SELECT started_at::text || ' ' || status || ' ' || left(execution_id::text,8) AS __text, execution_id::text AS __value FROM backtest_performance WHERE ('*' = ${config:sqlstring} OR execution_metadata->>'config_hash' = ${config:sqlstring}) AND ('*' = ${artifact:sqlstring} OR execution_metadata->>'artifact_path' = ${artifact:sqlstring}) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 500

targets.rawSql: SELECT execution_id, run_id, status, started_at, updated_at, finished_at, periodic_enabled, publication_errors, CASE WHEN status <> 'RUNNING' THEN 'finished' WHEN NOT periodic_enabled THEN 'final-only / no heartbeat expected' WHEN updated_at < now() - greatest(60, coalesce((execution_metadata->>'performance_interval')::double precision,10)*3) * interval '1 second' THEN 'stale: slow phase or interrupted; not proof of failure' ELSE 'recent checkpoint' END AS health FROM backtest_performance WHERE execution_id::text = ${execution:sqlstring}

SELECT (p.counters->>'ticks')::double precision / nullif(s.inclusive_seconds,0) AS overall_ticks_per_second, p.recent_ticks_per_second AS recent_interval_ticks_per_second, (p.counters->>'symbol_attempts')::double precision / nullif(s.inclusive_seconds,0) AS symbol_attempts_per_second FROM backtest_performance p LEFT JOIN backtest_performance_stages s ON s.execution_id=p.execution_id AND s.path='simulation' WHERE p.execution_id::text = ${execution:sqlstring}

SELECT wall_seconds, cpu_seconds, cpu_seconds/nullif(wall_seconds,0) AS average_cores, simulation_cpu_seconds, telemetry_seconds, 100*telemetry_seconds/nullif(wall_seconds,0) AS telemetry_percent FROM backtest_performance WHERE execution_id::text = ${execution:sqlstring}

SELECT counters->>'ticks' AS completed_ticks, counters->>'total_ticks' AS total_ticks, counters->>'symbol_attempts' AS symbol_attempts, counters->>'features' AS feature_computations, counters->>'predictions' AS predictions, counters->>'repository_calls' AS repository_calls, coalesce(counters->>'symbol_errors','0') AS symbol_errors, execution_metadata->>'symbol_count' AS symbols, execution_metadata->>'timeframe_minutes' AS timeframe_minutes, execution_metadata->>'lookback' AS lookback, execution_metadata->>'verbose_db' AS verbose_db, execution_metadata->>'profile_output' AS profile_output FROM backtest_performance WHERE execution_id::text = ${execution:sqlstring}

SELECT s.path, s.inclusive_seconds, 100*s.inclusive_seconds/nullif(p.wall_seconds,0) AS elapsed_percent FROM backtest_performance_stages s JOIN backtest_performance p USING(execution_id) WHERE s.execution_id::text = ${execution:sqlstring} AND s.path NOT LIKE '%/%' ORDER BY s.inclusive_seconds DESC

panels.title: Hotspots: exclusive ranking (never sum inclusive parents and children)

targets.rawSql: SELECT path, calls, exclusive_seconds, inclusive_seconds, inclusive_seconds/nullif(calls,0) AS mean_seconds, max_seconds FROM backtest_performance_stages WHERE execution_id::text = ${execution:sqlstring} ORDER BY exclusive_seconds DESC

SELECT p.wall_seconds, p.telemetry_seconds, coalesce(sum(s.inclusive_seconds),0) AS assigned_work_seconds, greatest(0,p.wall_seconds-p.telemetry_seconds-coalesce(sum(s.inclusive_seconds),0)) AS unassigned_seconds FROM backtest_performance p LEFT JOIN backtest_performance_stages s ON s.execution_id=p.execution_id AND s.path NOT LIKE '%/%' WHERE p.execution_id::text = ${execution:sqlstring} GROUP BY p.execution_id

panels.title: Run history — compare matching workload, cache, profiling and database modes

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.started_at, p.execution_id, p.status, p.wall_seconds, s.inclusive_seconds AS replay_seconds, (p.counters->>'ticks')::double precision/nullif(s.inclusive_seconds,0) AS ticks_per_second, p.execution_metadata->>'symbol_count' AS symbols, p.execution_metadata->>'timeframe_minutes' AS timeframe_minutes, p.execution_metadata->>'start' AS window_start, p.execution_metadata->>'end_exclusive' AS window_end, p.execution_metadata->>'verbose_db' AS verbose_db, p.execution_metadata->>'profile_output' AS profile_output, p.execution_metadata->>'config_hash' AS config_hash, p.execution_metadata->>'artifact_path' AS artifact FROM backtest_performance p LEFT JOIN backtest_performance_stages s ON s.execution_id=p.execution_id AND s.path='simulation' WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at) AND ('*' = ${config:sqlstring} OR p.execution_metadata->>'config_hash' = ${config:sqlstring}) AND ('*' = ${artifact:sqlstring} OR p.execution_metadata->>'artifact_path' = ${artifact:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.started_at DESC LIMIT 500
